title: Interesting mall world dream last night
content: Last night when I was in a hypnogogic state I tried to set my intentions to the mall world. Once asleep, it started off really odd, I was in a high-rise building that was not the mall and I had to get to the top floor. This part of the dream was really odd, as I had a distinct set of memories that weren’t mine. I can elaborate if needed but it’s long and not really mall-related. I took the elevator and ended up bursting through the roof of the building…And suddenly ended up in the mall. It started off in the bathroom maze, where I literally said out loud “hey, this is like those bathroom maze dreams!” and I feel like I slowly gained lucidity after this. Most of the dream was based off what my dream brain called “fast travel”, where I slid along the smooth, tiled floors of the mall world in various ways. First on my socks, then something I can’t remember, then an elaborate contraption made of flatbread. lmao. At this point in the dream I was like- wait a minute. I then gained lucidity fully and imagined me and my college ex in a tropical paradise. I’m still thinking about the mall though.
